hebrewText: זַמְּר֗וּ לַ֭/יהוָה יֹשֵׁ֣ב צִיּ֑וֹן הַגִּ֥ידוּ בָ֝/עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִֽילוֹתָֽי/ו

tokens.bdb: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
tokens.kjv: give praise, sing forth praises, psalms.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: play upon it; to make music
tokens.enLiteralWord: play upon it; to make music
tokens.explanation: play upon it; to make music
tokens.explanationEn: play upon it; to make music

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

tokens.bdb: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
tokens.kjv: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.

tokens.bdb: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem

properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
tokens.kjv: bewray, [idiom] certainly, certify, declare(-ing), denounce, expound, [idiom] fully, messenger, plainly, profess, rehearse, report, shew (forth), speak, [idiom] surely, tell, utter.

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
an exploit (of God), or a performance (of man, often in a bad sense); by implication, an opportunity
tokens.kjv: act(-ion), deed, doing, invention, occasion, work.
